_doc: Single registry of the 1994-only art recovered from the published screenshots (2026-10-16). Keys of `shapes` are synthetic shape ids (>= 2000) used by the vignettes' items/actors; they are NOT U8SHAPES ids and vignette_place.py refuses them until the art track gives each one a real id. Per shape: footprint in world units (x, y, z; TYPEFLAG semantics; null = never placed), sort flags for vignette_paint.Painter.add_shape, kind (sprite | sprite-partial | sprite-draft | sprite-patch | reference-crop | residual). A sprite-patch frame (2027, 2043) holds only the shot pixels a retail piece owns in the window: `base` names the retail (shape, frame) lv_art_props lays it over, `at` the piece's vignette-local spot, the hotspot the base frame's anchor. Per frame: repo-relative P-mode U8PAL PNG (index 255 = transparent), numeric hotspot (null = never placed, not observed), source shot and top-left, grade (cross-shot-validated | single-shot | reference-only | residual) from the cross-shot search of vignette_replay.py, or `derived` for a frame no shot shows that a tool redraws from a graded one (its `derived_from` and `tool` say which) (best class match in every other shot, in-bounds and >=50%-visible, plain and mirrored; validated = >=97% of the visible pixels, or >=85% with at most 3 mismatch blobs of >=10 px each = occluders), inferred_px = frame pixels never observed in any shot. reference-crop and residual frames must not be fed to any builder.

palette.note: Index 255 is a real colour (24,125,125) in U8PAL; these PNGs cannot carry it. Shot pixels that map to it: screen04 (139,78) (inside the striped prop 2014, lost there) and screen10 (86,126), (81,136).
